newsitem.title: USA: Borror closed 354 homes in Q4, up 15 pct.
newsitem.headline: Borror closed 354 homes in Q4, up 15 pct.

text.p: Borror Corp said it closed 354 homes in the fourth quarter of 1996, a 15 percent increase from the 309 closings in the fourth quarter of 1995.

The company sold 1308 single-family and condominium homes during 1996, four percent more than the 1253 homes sold last year. Additionally, backlog at December 31 was 688 units, a 21 percent increase over last year.
Borror said it received 253 home sales contracts during the quarter, compared to 254 during the fourth quarter of 1995.
